key_insight: UA-ChatDev makes multi-agent software development more reliable by estimating uncertainty in agent outputs and verifying only the risky ones before errors propagate.
engineering_relevance: For LLM-based coding assistants and autonomous dev pipelines, this adds a practical control layer to reduce hallucination-driven bugs without verifying every step.
method: Uses token-level log probabilities to estimate confidence in each agent response.
Applies phase-aware uncertainty thresholds to decide when to trigger retrieval-based verification.
Passes uncertain intermediate outputs through verification to prevent downstream error propagation.
evidence_signal: On the SRDD benchmark, the method outperformed single-agent and multi-agent baselines on completeness, executability, consistency, and overall quality, with ablations and communication analyses supporting improved execution reliability.
watch_item: The approach depends on well-calibrated uncertainty thresholds and log-probability signals, which may vary across models, tasks, and development phases.
paper_title: UA-ChatDev: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Reliable Software Development
